# search_areas

## Purpose

Find Camptocamp areas by name: mountain ranges, administrative subdivisions such as a French département or a Swiss canton, and countries, optionally narrowed by `area_type`. The returned ID is the `area_id` that [`search_routes`](search_routes.md), [`search_waypoints`](search_waypoints.md) and [`search_outings`](search_outings.md) take, so this is the usual first call for a question about a region. Towns are not areas: search for the range or the département instead.

## Inputs

| Parameter   | Type    | Required | Default | Constraints            |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `query`     | string  | yes      |         | at most 200 characters |
| `limit`     | integer | no       | `10`    | 1 to 50                |
| `offset`    | integer | no       | `0`     | ≥ 0                    |
| `lang`      | string  | no       |         |                        |
| `area_type` | string  | no       |         |                        |

- `query`: Area name in any language (e.g. 'Écrins', 'Valais', 'Wallis').
- `limit`: Maximum number of results.
- `offset`: Number of results to skip, for paging (offset + limit ≤ 10,000).
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`
- `area_type`: Restrict to one area type: range, admin_limits or country. Values: `range`, `admin_limits`, `country`
